msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia jardilin-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a row of children's leather Mary Jane shoes in lime green, orange and green, displayed on a wooden table in a shoe shop with a vintage carousel horse behind from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia jardilin-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of children's metallic silver and beige leather Mary Jane shoes with a strap from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia jardilin-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of children's Menorcan avarca sandal shoes in yellow, glitter and black from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia jardilin-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of children's tan and brown leather closed-toe T-bar sandal shoes from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia jardilin-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of children's sporty closed-toe sandal shoes in navy blue and lime green with a bungee lace from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
